en.headline: No own commits; 1 issue comment and 1 reply received
en.summary: On 2026-10-12, `sogeisetsu` recorded **0 own commits** across the day, with 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were logged. The single issue activity was a comment on `openchamber/openchamber` issue #4664, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity", posted at 2026-10-11T17:59:57Z. One reply was received on `anomalyco/opencode` issue #51263, titled "websearch: tinyfish provider returns HTTP 400 (missing Mcp-Session-Id) on every search", from `terry-an-investor`, confirming the failure on v2.0.27 and noting the failure is key-presence-dependent rather than universal.
